verses.gurmukhi: ਪੀਰ ਪਿਕੰਬਰ ਅਉਲੀਏ ਗਉਸ ਕੁਤਬ ਵਲੀਉਲਹ ਜਾਣੇ।
verses.translit_en: peer pika(n)bar aaule'ee gaus kutab valeeauleh jaane|

en.bdb: In this religion (Islam) the pirs, prophets, aulias, gauns, qutbs and waliullah are well known.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇਖ ਮਸਾਇਕ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਦਰਿ ਦਰਿਵੇਸ ਵਖਾਣੇ।
verses.translit_en: sekh masaik aakheean lakh lakh dhar dharives vakhaane|

en.bdb: Millions of sheikhs , mashaiks (practitioners) and dervishes are described in it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਹਦੇ ਲਖ ਸਹੀਦ ਹੋਇ ਲਖ ਅਬਦਾਲ ਮਲੰਗ ਮਿਲਾਣੇ।
verses.translit_en: suhadhe lakh saheedh hoi lakh abadhaal mala(n)g milaane|

en.bdb: Millions of mean people, martyrs, faquirs and carefree persons are there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਧੀ ਰੁਕਨ ਕਲੰਦਰਾਂ ਲਖ ਉਲਮਾਉ ਮੁਲਾ ਮਉਲਾਣੇ।
verses.translit_en: si(n)dhee rukan kala(n)dharaa(n) lakh ulamaau mulaa maulaane|

en.bdb: Millions of sindhi rukhans, ulmas and maulanas (all religious denominations) are available in it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਰੈ ਸਰੀਅਤ ਆਖੀਐ ਤਰਕ ਤਰੀਕਤਿ ਰਾਹ ਸਿਞਾਣੇ।
verses.translit_en: sarai sareeat aakheeaai tarak tareekat raeh sin(j)aane|

en.bdb: Many are there who give exposition to the Muslim code of conduct (shariat) and many go on debating on the basis of tariqat, the methods of spiritual purification.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਫ਼ਤੀ ਮਾਰੂਫ ਲਖ ਹਕ ਹਕੀਕਤਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ।
verses.translit_en: maaraphatee maaroof lakh hak hakeekat hukam samaane|

en.bdb: Myriad people have become famous by reaching the last stage of knowledge, the marfati and many in His divine Will have merged into the haqiqat, the truth.
Thousands of elderly people were born and got perished.
